subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does a workflow-security owner approve the exact new action revisions for the credential-bearing token, registry-login, and Codex-agent workflows in this PR?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about executing new external action code with repository secrets and tokens; no mechanical repair or generic CI result can substitute for owner authorization.

options.title: Audit and approve the revisions
options.body: Review the upstream source, release provenance, and permissions for every sensitive action revision, then refresh and merge the exact approved head.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Hold or close the grouped Dependabot update if the sensitive revisions cannot be approved together, then update only approved actions in narrower PRs.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream source, release provenance, and permissions for every sensitive action revision, then refresh and merge the exact approved head.
